Title: great beast calls great beast, contest? LSJ

Messages.Author: Blooded Sand
Messages.Body:
Great beast is in play, is Clan impersonated to Baali, and has 2
discipline skill cards making him 11 cap. Can he take the great beast
action?

Messages.Author: Nikolaj "Lord of the Betrayers" Wendt
Messages.Body:
On Nov 30, 3:05 pm, Blooded Sand <sandm...@gmail.com> wrote:
> Great beast is in play, is Clan impersonated to Baali, and has 2
> discipline skill cards making him 11 cap. Can he take the great beast
> action?

I am sure you can. You burn the acting one first I believe.

When this card has more than 10 ritual counters, burn this Baali and
choose three Disciplines. This card becomes a unique clanless
independent infernal vampire with 9 capacity, 4 strength and 3 bleed.

Messages.Author: Teeka
Messages.Body:
On 30 nov, 15:05, Blooded Sand <sandm...@gmail.com> wrote:
> Great beast is in play, is Clan impersonated to Baali, and has 2
> discipline skill cards making him 11 cap. Can he take the great beast
> action?

Sure, why not? The action card itself is not unique. The card only
becomes a unique vampire (Great Beast no2) when it triggers, at which
point the acting vampire (Great Beast no1) burns. So no contest ever
occurs.

an action that would result in an illegal result, eg. a 10 cap baali
taking the second GB action

Messages.Author: John Flournoy
Messages.Body:
On Nov 30, 9:14 am, Blooded Sand <sandm...@gmail.com> wrote:

> There was the whole argument a while ago about not being able to take
> an action that would result in an illegal result, eg. a 10 cap baali
> taking the second GB action

And it would be an illegal action if it didn't burn the first GB in
the process. However, the result of the action is 'there's one and
only one GB in play', so there's no illegality, so you can do it.

-John Flournoy
